item.title: About
item.author: sgarzare@redhat.com (Stefano Garzarella)
item.description:
Linux’s AF_VSOCK maintainer, rust-vmm and COCONUT SVSM co-maintainer. Working in open source projects related to virtualization, virtio devices/drivers, confidential VMs, etc.

Whenever I get the chance, I love speaking about open source. Take a look at the archive of my past and upcoming talks.

The postings on this site are my own and don’t necessarily represent Red Hat’s positions, strategies or opinions.
